fact: Parent SegmentedControl capture warned about arbitrary native Slot payload even though Segment already permits it.
cause: Parent warning scoper required its own optional target/policy for every nested Slot. Copying them into the parent can invalidate absent optional targets and enclosing contexts.
fix: Native-only diagnostics prove SLOT type/binding, typed exact owner and current independent reference; filter only descendants from the exact unmatched-baseline producer marker.
protection: 1404 full tests; 56 real retained captures,30 owner contexts,12 expected findings,one warning removed; wrong/unknown/missing boundaries and marker refused; raw evidence and non-payload warnings preserved.
firstHarnessFailures: Wrong standalone Segment replay / negative scope corrected through existing validated enclosing context; malformed unknownFacts refused before calling helpers. These were not engine defects.
workflow: A diagnostic-only gap must not be repaired by inventing extra component norms or duplicating optional Slot policies. Existing skill0.1.10 retained; regression eval saved.
